description: Morningstar quote page data for a US stock, ETF or mutual fund: name, ticker, Morningstar star rating, key statistics shown free on the page (stocks: previous close, day and 52-week range, bid/ask, market cap, P/E, P/S, dividend yield, sector, industry, style box, employees), top-10 holdings with weight, market value and sector plus portfolio date (ETFs/funds), and the analyst report headline. Subscriber-only values are omitted. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

exchange.description: Morningstar exchange code (default xnas for stocks/funds, arcx for ETFs; e.g. xnys, bats)
